mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ultary_ai_request_log ( user_no, feature_type, target_feed_id, target_pet_id, prompt, result, model_name, used_token_count, status, error_message, moderation_job_id, target_type, target_id, content_version, attempt_no, latency_ms, http_status, error_code ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{featureType}, #{targetFeedId}, #{targetPetId}, #{prompt}, #{result}, #{modelName}, #{usedTokenCount}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{moderationJobId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{contentVersion}, #{attemptNo}, #{latencyMs}, #{httpStatus}, #{errorCode} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ultary_ai_request_log WHERE status = 'FAILED'
mapper.sql: l.ai_request_id, l.user_no, l.feature_type, l.target_feed_id, l.target_type, l.target_id, l.moderation_job_id, l.content_version, l.attempt_no, l.model_name, l.status, l.error_code, l.error_message, l.latency_ms, l.http_status, l.created_at, j.status AS job_status, j.result_action, j.attempt_count AS job_attempt_count, j.next_attempt_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ultary_ai_request_log l LEFT JOIN ultary_ai_moderation_job j ON j.job_id = l.moderation_job_id WHERE l.ai_request_id = #{aiRequestId}
